Name: Intel Extreme Tuning Utility (XTU)
What: Intel tool to monitor the CPU, adjust power limits and voltages and run stress tests.
IfNeeded: Needed if you overclock or undervolt, or if you check temperatures and throttling, especially on unlocked CPUs or laptops with adjustable limits.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use it, remove it. If the app is not installed, only orphaned components are left and they can be removed.

Name: HP telemetry (HP Analytics)
What: HP component that collects usage and status data of the device.
IfNeeded: Only needed for HP diagnostics and support.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not want to send data to HP you can remove it: Windows works normally.

Match: hpcustomcap|hpomencustomcap|wirelessbuttondriver|HP Wireless|accelerometer|Application Enabling|Device Health|Omen Software|HP Audio Hardware
Name: HP and Omen special functions support
What: HP services and drivers for function keys, airplane mode key, sensors, lighting and audio integration of the laptop.
IfNeeded: They are needed for the special functions of the laptop.
IfNotNeeded: They weigh very little: it is better to keep them even if you do not use them.

Match: iigd_dch|iigd_ext|igcc_dch|cui_dch|UHD Graphics|HD Graphics|Iris|Graphics Command Center|Graphics Control Panel
Name: Intel graphics driver
What: Driver of the Intel integrated graphics and components of the graphics control panel.
IfNeeded: Needed for the screen and video acceleration.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove it: update it to the latest version and then remove the old versions.

Name: Intel Rapid Storage and Optane
What: Intel storage drivers (RST, RAID, Optane) and the related management components.
IfNeeded: Needed if the system disk is managed by Intel RST (RAID or RST mode in the BIOS).
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove the controller driver: risk of a boot error. Optane components can be removed only if you do not use Optane.

Name: Intel Management Engine (software components)
What: Intel services for remote management (AMT), licenses and security tied to the chipset firmware.
IfNeeded: Only needed with Intel AMT remote management or with Intel software that requires them.
IfNotNeeded: On a personal PC they are harmless and removable, but Windows Update or Intel drivers may reinstall them.

Name: Intel chipset and platform
What: Basic chipset drivers: Management Engine interface, thermal and power management (DPTF), I2C and GPIO for touchpad and sensors.
IfNeeded: Needed for temperatures, touchpad and power saving of the laptop.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove them. To update them use Windows Update or the manufacturer driver assistant.

Name: NVIDIA driver
What: Components of the NVIDIA graphics card: HDMI or DisplayPort audio, virtual audio for recording and streaming, power and platform control.
IfNeeded: Needed if you use the NVIDIA GPU, even only for games or HDMI output.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove the single pieces: to clean up, reinstall the package from the NVIDIA website with a clean installation.

Name: Manufacturer audio effects and services
What: Audio extensions (equalizer, effects, microphone) from Realtek and Sound Research, often customized by the PC manufacturer.
IfNeeded: Needed for effects, profiles and some microphone and speaker functions.
IfNotNeeded: Sound works with the basic driver too, but you may lose effects and quality: it is better to keep them.

Name: Virtual gamepad emulator (ViGEm)
What: Driver that creates virtual controllers for DS4Windows, Steam Input, emulators and some HP and Omen software.
IfNeeded: Needed if you use those programs.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use emulated controllers you can remove it.

Name: NVMe SSD controller
What: Driver of the NVMe SSD controller, the disk Windows usually starts from.
IfNeeded: Needed if the PC has an NVMe SSD: the system disk almost always depends on it, never remove it.
IfNotNeeded: Remove only if you are sure the SSD is no longer in this PC (old driver of a disk you replaced) and the PC works normally.

Name: USB tethering of the phone (RNDIS)
What: Windows driver that lets the phone share its connection through the USB cable.
IfNeeded: Windows uses it when you turn on USB tethering on the phone.
IfNotNeeded: As a ghost device it is safe to remove: Windows installs it again the next time you use USB tethering.

Name: Drivers for phones and tablets (Samsung, Huawei, Xiaomi, Apple, Google)
What: USB, modem and network (tethering) drivers to connect phones and tablets: ADB, Smart Switch, iTunes, advanced file transfer.
IfNeeded: Needed for ADB, Smart Switch, DeX, iTunes or USB tethering. To copy files the MTP driver already included in Windows is enough.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use them, remove them: when you plug the phone in again Windows reinstalls them by itself if needed. Warning: if the PC has a MediaTek Wi-Fi or Bluetooth card, do not remove its drivers.

Name: Virtual machine adapters
What: Network and virtual device drivers created by VirtualBox or VMware.
IfNeeded: Needed if you use virtual machines.
IfNotNeeded: If you no longer use them, uninstall the virtualization program from the apps.

Name: VPN adapters
What: Virtual network adapters installed by VPN clients.
IfNeeded: Needed if you use that VPN.
IfNotNeeded: If you no longer use it, uninstall the VPN client from the apps.

Name: Microsoft streaming service proxy
What: Windows system component for audio and video streaming.
IfNeeded: Windows recreates it by itself when needed.
IfNotNeeded: Removing the ghost entry makes no difference: it will come back.

Name: TVs and network devices (DLNA, Miracast)
What: Memories of TVs, boxes and screens found on the network or through Wi-Fi Direct.
IfNeeded: They are recreated by themselves when the device is on and visible on the network.
IfNotNeeded: Removing the ghosts is safe.

Name: USB sticks and disks used in the past
What: Memories of USB drives that were plugged in before.
IfNeeded: They are recreated when plugged in: only the first installation changes.
IfNotNeeded: Removing the ghosts is safe.

Name: Stored audio outputs and inputs
What: Memories of speakers, microphones and headphones used in the past (also Bluetooth).
IfNeeded: They are recreated when the device is plugged in.
IfNotNeeded: Removing the ghosts is safe.

Name: Paired Bluetooth devices
What: Paired devices and the services they offer (audio, network, file transfer).
IfNeeded: Keep the pairing if you use the device.
IfNotNeeded: To also delete the pairing keys use the Bluetooth tab.

Name: Touchpad (ELAN, Synaptics)
What: Laptop touchpad driver: multi-finger gestures, sensitivity and advanced settings.
IfNeeded: Needed if you use the touchpad with advanced gestures.
IfNotNeeded: On laptops do not remove them: without the manufacturer driver the touchpad works only in a basic way.

Name: USB network adapter (Ethernet dongle, dock)
What: Driver of USB network adapters, such as Ethernet dongles and docking stations.
IfNeeded: Needed if you connect to the network through that adapter: removing it cuts the connection.
IfNotNeeded: Remove it only if the adapter is no longer used: Windows installs it again when you plug the adapter in.

Name: Realtek hardware drivers (network, Bluetooth, webcam, audio)
What: Realtek drivers for Ethernet or Wi-Fi network card, Bluetooth adapter, webcam and audio codec.
IfNeeded: Needed if the PC uses that hardware: removing them can take away network, Bluetooth, webcam or audio.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove them. To update them use Windows Update or the PC manufacturer support.

Name: System firmware update (UEFI/BIOS)
What: Driver that lets Windows update the firmware of the PC (UEFI/BIOS) through Windows Update.
IfNeeded: Needed to receive firmware updates from the manufacturer.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove it: it is a system component.

Name: Intel Smart Sound audio
What: Drivers of the Intel Smart Sound audio controller and its parts: digital microphones, SoundWire, I2S, Bluetooth and USB audio, voice detection.
IfNeeded: Needed for digital microphones and some integrated audio outputs.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove it: it can take away the microphone or audio.

Name: File transfer with phones (MTP)
What: Microsoft driver to transfer files between the PC and phones or cameras in MTP mode.
IfNeeded: Needed to copy photos and files from phones and cameras with a cable.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not connect phones or cameras you can remove it: Windows reinstalls it when needed.

Name: Card reader (SD)
What: Driver of the SD card reader built into the PC.
IfNeeded: Needed if you use the card reader.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use it you can leave it: it takes very little space and Windows reinstalls it.

Name: Brother printer, scanner and fax drivers
What: Drivers of Brother printers, multifunction devices and fax, one package for each model installed at some time.
IfNeeded: Needed if you still use that Brother printer or scanner (also over the network: it may look 'not connected' when it is switched off).
IfNotNeeded: If you no longer own that model you can remove it: Windows or the Brother installer adds it again when you connect the printer.

Name: EPSON printer drivers
What: Drivers of EPSON printers (inkjet, receipt printers) and of their USB controller.
IfNeeded: Needed if you still use that EPSON printer (also over the network: it may look 'not connected' when it is switched off).
IfNotNeeded: If you no longer own that model you can remove it: Windows or the EPSON installer adds it again when you connect the printer.

Match: prnms0|Print to PDF|Coda di stampa radice|Root Print Queue|XPS Document Writer|OneNote
Name: Microsoft virtual printers (Print to PDF, XPS)
What: Drivers of the virtual printers of Windows: 'Microsoft Print to PDF' and 'Microsoft XPS Document Writer'.
IfNeeded: Needed if you save documents as PDF from the print dialog.
IfNotNeeded: Harmless and small. Keep them unless you never print to PDF.

Name: Intel graphics parts (SGPC, HDMI/DisplayPort audio)
What: Parts that come with the Intel graphics driver: the graphics power component and the audio that travels over HDMI or DisplayPort.
IfNeeded: Needed with Intel graphics: they are installed together with the graphics driver.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove them on their own: update the Intel graphics driver as a whole.

Name: Intel platform components (firmware interface, PCIe, ME)
What: Small Intel drivers of the motherboard: interface to the graphics firmware, PCI Express switch, management engine extension.
IfNeeded: Needed on Intel PCs: they are installed by the chipset and management packages.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove them: they are tiny and the PC may lose features. Update them with Windows Update or the PC maker.

Name: Intel Wi-Fi extensions (PROSet/Wireless)
What: Extensions of the Intel Wi-Fi driver that add settings and features.
IfNeeded: Needed if the PC has an Intel Wi-Fi card.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove them: Wi-Fi settings may stop working. Update them with Windows Update.

Name: Intel USB Flash Loader (old phone modems)
What: Very old (2013) driver used to update the firmware of Intel modems in phones and tablets.
IfNeeded: Needed only if you update the firmware of an Intel-based modem.
IfNotNeeded: Almost nobody needs it: you can remove it.

Name: SoftPerfect virtual disk driver
What: Virtual bus of SoftPerfect programs (RAM Disk, virtual disks).
IfNeeded: Needed if you use SoftPerfect RAM Disk or similar programs. If a virtual device is connected it is in use now.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use SoftPerfect programs you can remove it, after uninstalling the program.

Name: Realtek webcam drivers (one for each PC brand)
What: Realtek drivers for the integrated camera: Windows keeps one package for each laptop brand (HP, Acer, Asus, Samsung...). Only the one that matches your camera is in use.
IfNeeded: The one used by your camera is needed (the program keeps it: it is in use).
IfNotNeeded: The others are not used by any connected camera: you can remove them. Windows adds one again only if you connect a camera that needs it.

Name: Realtek audio drivers (variants by PC model)
What: Realtek High Definition Audio packages: one variant for each PC model of the manufacturer. Only one is used by your sound card, and it may also be a Windows one.
IfNeeded: Needed: your PC uses one of the variants (or the Windows one).
IfNotNeeded: Many unused variants are harmless and are added back by Windows Update. Remove them only to tidy up, and only after checking that sound works.

Name: Virtual machine drivers (QEMU / KVM / Proxmox VirtIO)
What: Drivers of the virtual hardware of QEMU/KVM machines (Proxmox, oVirt...): disk, network, graphics, serial, balloon and others. They come with the VirtIO guest tools.
IfNeeded: Needed if this PC is a virtual machine on QEMU/KVM/Proxmox: disk, network and screen depend on them. Do not remove those in use.
IfNotNeeded: On a physical PC they are useless and can be removed. On a virtual machine remove only older versions and drivers of virtual hardware you removed from the VM.

Name: Citrix USB redirection drivers
What: Drivers of Citrix Workspace/Receiver that pass USB devices to remote desktops.
IfNeeded: Needed if you use Citrix Workspace and redirect USB devices to a remote session.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use Citrix you can remove them.

Match: ipf_acpi|ipf_cpu|ipf_smbus|ipf_|Innovation Platform Framework|\bdptf|Dynamic Platform and Thermal|Dynamic Tuning
Name: Intel Innovation Platform Framework (DPTF)
What: Intel component that manages the power and temperature limits of the CPU and of the PC (thermal and power management).
IfNeeded: Keep it on laptops and mini PCs: it helps control heat, fan and performance, and the maker may rely on it.
IfNotNeeded: Removing it can change the fan and performance behavior. Remove it only if you are sure the PC does not need it.

Name: Microsoft Voice Clarity (noise suppression)
What: Microsoft audio effect that reduces background noise in calls and recordings.
IfNeeded: Keep it if you make calls or record with the microphone.
IfNotNeeded: It is small and harmless. If you never use the microphone you can leave it anyway: Windows can add it back.

Name: Npcap packet capture driver
What: Network packet capture driver used by Wireshark, Nmap and similar tools. Several versions can stay in the driver store.
IfNeeded: Needed only if you use Wireshark, Nmap or other network analysis tools. Keep the newest version.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use those tools, remove it. Older versions next to a newer one can be removed.

Match: Basic Display|Basic Render|Scheda video di base|Driver rendering base|Driver video base
Name: Microsoft Basic Display Adapter
What: Windows fallback graphics driver, used when no specific driver is installed for the graphics card.
IfNeeded: It works as a temporary driver. For full speed, resolutions and video decoding install the right graphics driver (Updates tab or the PC maker).
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove it: without it the screen could stay black. Install the real graphics driver instead.

Match: System Management Bus Controller|SMBus|PCI Memory Controller|DEV_A2A3|DEV_A2A1|Data Acquisition and Signal Processing|Signal Processing Controller|Thermal Subsystem|DEV_A2B1|Controller acquisizione dati|Controller del bus di gestione|Controller memoria PCI
Name: Intel chipset small devices (SMBus, memory controller, thermal sensor)
What: Small parts of the Intel chipset: the system management bus, a memory-mapped controller and the temperature sensor block. Windows often shows them without a driver.
IfNeeded: They normally work without a special driver. If one shows an error, install the chipset package of the PC maker or the Intel chipset driver.
IfNotNeeded: Nothing to remove: they are real parts of the motherboard.

Name: Intel Bluetooth adapter
What: The Bluetooth part of Intel Wi-Fi/Bluetooth cards (USB or PCIe).
IfNeeded: Needed for Bluetooth mouse, keyboard, headphones. If it shows "no driver", install the Intel Wireless Bluetooth driver (catalog or PC maker).
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove it if you use Bluetooth. If the PC has no Bluetooth use at all it can stay unused.

Name: Intel HDMI/DisplayPort audio
What: Audio output of the Intel graphics over HDMI or DisplayPort (monitor or TV speakers).
IfNeeded: Needed to hear sound through an HDMI/DisplayPort screen. It is installed with the Intel graphics driver.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove it if you use the speakers of a monitor or TV. A generic Microsoft driver works too.

Name: Realtek High Definition Audio codec
What: The sound chip of most motherboards and laptops (Realtek ALC...).
IfNeeded: Windows has its own driver that plays sound. The Realtek/maker package adds the control panel, effects and extra jacks.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove it: it is the sound card. To get more features install the maker package.

Name: Intel Ethernet (LAN)
What: Intel wired network card driver.
IfNeeded: Needed for the cable network. Windows includes a driver that works. The Intel/maker one may add options such as teaming and offload.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove it if the PC uses the cable network. Replace it only if you have network problems.

Name: Realtek Ethernet (LAN)
What: Realtek wired network card driver.
IfNeeded: Needed for the cable network. The Windows driver works, but the Realtek/maker one is sometimes better for speed and stability.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove it if the PC uses the cable network. Update it only if you have disconnections or low speed.

Name: Intel Wi-Fi
What: Driver of the Intel wireless network card.
IfNeeded: Needed for Wi-Fi. If Wi-Fi drops or is slow, a newer Intel driver often helps.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove it if the PC uses Wi-Fi. Keep the newest version.

Name: Qualcomm / MediaTek Wi-Fi and Bluetooth
What: Driver of Qualcomm or MediaTek wireless cards, common in new laptops and mini PCs.
IfNeeded: Needed for Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. The PC maker driver is usually the best tested.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove it if you use Wi-Fi or Bluetooth. Update from the maker or the catalog if you have drops.

Name: Killer network (Intel / Rivet)
What: Network driver and tools of the "Killer" cards (Rivet Networks, now Intel) with traffic prioritization.
IfNeeded: Needed only if you use the Killer Control Center to prioritize games or traffic. The card itself needs a network driver.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove the network driver. The extra Killer software can be removed if you do not use it.

Name: AMD Ryzen Master
What: AMD tool and driver to monitor the Ryzen CPU and change frequencies and voltages.
IfNeeded: Needed if you overclock or monitor the CPU with Ryzen Master.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use it, remove it. If the app is not installed only leftovers remain and they can be removed.

Name: AMD chipset and platform
What: AMD platform drivers: security processor, power management, GPIO, I2C, SMBus and PCI.
IfNeeded: Needed on AMD Ryzen PCs for power plans, sleep, touchpad and sensors. Keep them.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove them. Update from the AMD chipset package or the PC maker if you have power or sleep problems.

Name: AMD Radeon graphics
What: Driver of AMD graphics (Radeon, also the one built into Ryzen CPUs) and its HDMI audio.
IfNeeded: Needed for graphics speed, resolutions and games. Update it from AMD, the PC maker or the catalog.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove it: the screen would fall back to the basic driver. Remove old leftover versions only.

Name: Intel Serial IO (I2C, GPIO, UART, SPI)
What: Intel chipset drivers that talk to small devices: touchpad, touchscreen, sensors, keyboard backlight.
IfNeeded: Needed on laptops: without them the touchpad or touchscreen may stop working.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove them. Update only through the maker or Intel chipset package.

Match: Integrated Sensor Solution|Sensor Hub|Platform Monitoring Technology|iaPMT|Intel.*Sensor
Name: Intel sensors and platform monitoring
What: Intel sensor hub: accelerometer, screen rotation, light and platform telemetry.
IfNeeded: Needed for auto-rotation and brightness on 2-in-1 laptops and tablets.
IfNotNeeded: On a desktop PC it does nothing visible. Keep it anyway: it is small and part of the platform.

Name: Intel VMD and GNA
What: VMD is a storage controller of some Intel PCs (it hides NVMe disks behind a driver). GNA is a small AI accelerator.
IfNeeded: VMD: if the PC uses it, the disk needs this driver: without it Windows may not see the drive. GNA: used for noise reduction in calls.
IfNotNeeded: Never remove VMD on a PC that boots from it. GNA can stay: it is small.

Name: Thunderbolt / USB4
What: Controller and drivers for Thunderbolt and USB4 ports (fast docks, external disks, monitors).
IfNeeded: Needed to use Thunderbolt docks and devices. Updates come from the PC maker or Intel.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove it if you use Thunderbolt/USB4 devices. Without them the ports still work as USB.

Match: AI Boost|Neural Processing|\bNPU\b|Ryzen AI|\bIPU\b|Windows Studio Effects
Name: NPU / AI accelerator
What: Driver of the AI processor (NPU) of new CPUs: used for Windows Studio Effects (camera blur, eye contact) and local AI features.
IfNeeded: Needed only for those AI functions. Newer drivers come from the PC maker or Windows Update.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use camera effects or local AI you can leave it: it is small and does not slow the PC.

Name: TPM / Microsoft Pluton security chip
What: Security chip that keeps keys for BitLocker, Windows Hello and secure start.
IfNeeded: Needed for BitLocker, Windows Hello, Windows 11 requirements and some apps.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove it. It is part of the PC security.

Name: Microsoft Surface drivers
What: Drivers of Surface devices: pen, touch, keyboard cover, dock, sensors and power.
IfNeeded: Needed on Surface devices. Updates come through Windows Update.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove them on a Surface.

Name: Dell helper components
What: Dell helper services and drivers: updates, diagnostics, performance profiles and peripherals.
IfNeeded: Keep Dell Command | Update if you want the maker updates. Peripheral Manager is needed for Dell keyboards and mice settings.
IfNotNeeded: The others (SupportAssist, Digital Delivery, SmartByte) can be removed if you do not use them.

Name: Lenovo helper components
What: Lenovo drivers and services: hotkeys, battery modes, Vantage, keyboard backlight and system interface.
IfNeeded: The Lenovo utility/hotkeys driver is needed for the Fn keys and battery modes. Vantage is optional.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove the hotkey and system interface drivers. The Vantage app and promotional parts can be removed.

Name: ASUS helper components
What: ASUS drivers and services: Fn keys (ATK), system control interface, Armoury Crate, fan and RGB control.
IfNeeded: The ATK / System Control Interface driver is needed for Fn keys and brightness on ASUS laptops. Armoury Crate is optional.
IfNotNeeded: Keep ATK and System Control Interface. Armoury Crate and old AsIO drivers left by tuning tools can be removed if you do not use them.

Name: MSI helper components
What: MSI drivers and services: MSI Center, fan and performance modes, keyboard lighting and Nahimic audio.
IfNeeded: Needed on MSI laptops for Fn keys and performance modes. The rest is optional.
IfNotNeeded: Keep the Fn/system interface. MSI Center and Nahimic extras can be removed if you do not use them.

Name: Acer helper components
What: Acer services and drivers: Quick Access (Fn keys), Care Center and updates.
IfNeeded: Quick Access is needed for the Fn keys on Acer laptops.
IfNotNeeded: Care Center and other helper apps can be removed if you do not use them.

Name: Gaming peripherals (Razer, Logitech, Corsair...)
What: Drivers and services of keyboards, mice, headsets and capture devices from gaming brands.
IfNeeded: Needed only for the extra functions (macros, lighting, profiles). Basic use works with Windows drivers.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use the brand software, remove it. Mice and keyboards keep working as normal ones.

Name: VR headsets
What: Drivers and virtual devices of VR headsets (Meta Quest/Rift, HTC Vive, SteamVR, Windows Mixed Reality...).
IfNeeded: Needed if you use the headset with this PC.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use VR or the app is not installed, the leftovers can be removed.

Name: Steam virtual devices
What: Virtual speakers, microphone and controller drivers added by Steam for Remote Play and gamepads.
IfNeeded: Needed only for Steam Remote Play and Steam Input.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use Steam streaming they can be removed: Steam adds them again when needed.

Name: Virtual CD/DVD drives
What: Drivers of programs that mount disc images (ISO) as virtual drives.
IfNeeded: Needed only if you use that program to mount images. Windows can mount ISO files by itself.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use it, remove it. These old drivers can also cause problems.

Name: Corporate VPN (Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto...)
What: Virtual network adapters and filters of company VPN clients.
IfNeeded: Needed if you connect to a company or school network with that VPN. Your IT department may require it.
IfNotNeeded: If the VPN program is gone or you no longer use it, the leftover adapter can be removed.

Name: Remote access and virtual monitors
What: Drivers added by remote control programs: virtual screens, virtual printers and input devices.
IfNeeded: Needed only while you use that program. They also create virtual monitors that can look like ghost devices.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use the program, remove them: it adds them back at the next install.

Match: VB-Audio|VoiceMeeter|VB-Cable|Virtual Audio Cable|Voicemod|Wave Link|Equalizer APO|SteelSeries Sonar
Name: Virtual audio cables and mixers
What: Virtual sound cards used to route or process sound (streaming, voice changers, equalizers).
IfNeeded: Needed only if you use that audio tool.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use it, remove it. Otherwise it adds useless sound devices.

Match: PDFCreator|CutePDF|doPDF|Bullzip|Adobe PDF|PDF24|Foxit PDF Printer|PrimoPDF|Nitro PDF|Universal Document Converter
Name: Virtual PDF printers
What: Virtual printers that create PDF files (PDFCreator, CutePDF, doPDF, PDF24...).
IfNeeded: Needed if you print to PDF with that program.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use it or the app is not installed, you can remove it. Windows already has its own Microsoft Print to PDF.

Name: Printer and scanner drivers (HP, Canon, Xerox...)
What: Printer and scanner drivers and helper software.
IfNeeded: Keep the driver of every printer or scanner you still use, also at work.
IfNotNeeded: Remove the drivers of printers you no longer have. Never remove them if the printer is only turned off.

Name: License dongles (CodeMeter, HASP, Sentinel)
What: Drivers of USB protection keys that unlock professional programs.
IfNeeded: Needed if you use software that asks for the USB key (CAD, accounting, music...).
IfNotNeeded: If you no longer use that software, remove it. If unsure, keep it: it is small.

Match: CCID|OmniKey|Bit4id|ArubaKey|Gemalto|Identiv|SCM Microsystems|ACS ACR|Smart Card Reader|Lettore di smart card
Name: Smart card and digital signature readers
What: Drivers of smart card readers and USB tokens used for digital signature, electronic ID and bank access.
IfNeeded: Needed if you sign documents digitally, use an electronic ID or a bank token.
IfNotNeeded: Keep them if you use signature or ID cards, also rarely. Remove only the readers you no longer own.

Match: Generic PnP Monitor|Generic Monitor|monitor\.inf|Monitor PnP generico
Name: Generic PnP monitor
What: Windows driver of a monitor connected to the PC. Every screen you ever connected can leave an entry.
IfNeeded: If the monitor is connected, keep it.
IfNotNeeded: Entries of monitors that are not connected any more are ghosts and can be removed safely.

Name: Hyper-V and WSL virtual network
What: Virtual network switches and adapters created by Windows for Hyper-V, WSL and Windows Sandbox.
IfNeeded: Needed if you use virtual machines, WSL or Docker with these features.
IfNotNeeded: They are part of Windows: do not remove them. If you do not use them, they do no harm.

Name: Intel Wireless Manageability
What: Part of Intel vPro/AMT remote management for the Wi-Fi card: lets an IT department reach the PC even when Windows is not running.
IfNeeded: Useful only in companies that manage the PC remotely with Intel tools.
IfNotNeeded: At home it does nothing useful but weighs very little. It is safer to leave it, it comes with the Intel Wi-Fi driver.

Name: BERT Reader (boot error report)
What: Windows component that reads the hardware errors the firmware saved during the previous start (BERT table), so Windows can report them.
IfNeeded: Used by Windows error reporting for hardware problems.
IfNotNeeded: Part of the Intel chipset support: keep it.

Name: Intel HID Event Filter
What: Handles some special keys and buttons of laptops and tablets (airplane mode, rotation lock, power button events).
IfNeeded: Needed for those special keys to work.
IfNotNeeded: If you remove it some function keys may stop working. Keep it.

Name: Microphone settings of the PC maker (extension)
What: Small extension that adds the maker custom settings for the built-in digital microphones (Intel or AMD). Several copies exist, one per laptop model: only the one of your model is used.
IfNeeded: The one that matches your laptop is needed for the microphones to work as designed.
IfNotNeeded: The copies for other models are inactive and harmless. They are listed as "not used": removing them is not needed.

Name: Realtek OVWrap2 component
What: Helper of the Realtek audio software used to apply sound effects and settings.
IfNeeded: Needed if you use the Realtek or maker audio control panel.
IfNotNeeded: If you remove it the audio effects of the maker may stop working: keep it unless you do not use them.

Name: Sonix integrated camera (image processing)
What: Extension of the webcam driver (Sonix chip): it improves the image of the built-in camera.
IfNeeded: Needed for the maker image settings of the webcam.
IfNotNeeded: The camera may still work with the basic Windows driver but with a worse image. Keep it.

Match: Xbox Wireless Adapter|XBOX 360|XInput|DualSense|DualShock|Wireless Controller|Nintendo|Joy-?Con|Pro Controller|8BitDo|Gamepad|Game Controller|Controller di gioco|vJoy|HidHide|reWASD|x360ce|Joystick
Name: Game controllers (Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo, joysticks)
What: Drivers of gamepads, joysticks and their wireless adapters.
IfNeeded: Needed if you play with a controller connected to this PC.
IfNotNeeded: If the controller is not connected you can remove the driver: Windows installs it again when you connect it.

Name: Xbox and Game Pass support
What: Drivers installed by Windows with the Xbox app and Gaming Services: the game filter and the virtual disk where Xbox or Microsoft Store games are installed.
IfNeeded: Needed to install and run games from the Xbox app, Game Pass or the Microsoft Store.
IfNotNeeded: If you never play those games they do no harm. Do not remove them if you plan to use the Xbox app.

Name: Fingerprint reader
What: Driver of the fingerprint sensor that Windows Hello uses to sign you in with your finger.
IfNeeded: Needed if you sign in or confirm purchases with your fingerprint.
IfNotNeeded: If you never use the fingerprint you can remove it: the sensor stops working and Windows runs normally. Windows may install it again by itself.

Match: Windows Hello|Face Authentication|IR Camera|Infrared|Hello Face|IR Sensor|Camera a infrarossi|Fotocamera a infrarossi
Name: Face recognition camera (Windows Hello)
What: Infrared camera and sensor that Windows Hello uses to recognise your face.
IfNeeded: Needed if you unlock the PC with your face.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use face sign-in you can remove it: the normal webcam keeps working.

Name: Graphics tablet (Wacom, Huion, XP-Pen...)
What: Driver of a graphics tablet or pen display.
IfNeeded: Needed if you draw or write with the tablet.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use it, remove it. If the app is not installed only leftover components remain and they can be removed.

Name: USB-to-serial adapter or development board
What: Driver of USB-serial adapters and boards (Arduino, ESP32, programmers, serial consoles for routers).
IfNeeded: Needed if you program boards or connect to devices through a serial port.
IfNotNeeded: If the adapter is not connected you can remove it: Windows or the maker's installer usually installs it again when you plug the device in.

Name: Sound effects (Dolby, DTS, Waves, Creative...)
What: Components that add sound effects, equalizers or surround to the audio driver.
IfNeeded: Needed only if you use those effects: the sound itself works without them.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use the effects you can remove them. If the app is not installed only leftovers remain and they can be removed.

Name: USB docks and display adapters (DisplayLink)
What: Driver of USB docking stations and USB video adapters that add monitors through the USB port.
IfNeeded: Needed if you use a dock or adapter with DisplayLink: without it those monitors stay black.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use such a dock or adapter you can remove it. If the app is not installed only leftovers remain.

Name: Broadcom and Atheros Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and network
What: Driver of Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and network chips of Broadcom and Atheros, common in older laptops.
IfNeeded: Needed if that chip is your Wi-Fi, Bluetooth or network card: removing it can leave you offline.
IfNotNeeded: Remove it only if that chip is no longer in the PC and the network works with another adapter.

Match: HP Wolf|Sure (Click|Sense|Recover|Run|Start)|HP Support Assistant|HP Client Security|HP Collaboration|HP Easy Clean|HP Smart|hpsmart
Name: HP security and support tools
What: HP Wolf Security, Sure Sense/Click/Recover, Support Assistant, Easy Clean and similar tools.
IfNeeded: Needed if you use those HP tools: the security ones protect the PC while they are installed.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use them you can remove them. If the app is not installed only leftovers remain. Check that another antivirus protects the PC before removing the security ones.

Name: Scanners
What: Drivers and utilities of document and photo scanners (ScanSnap, CanoScan, Plustek, PaperStream...).
IfNeeded: Needed if you use that scanner with this PC.
IfNotNeeded: If the scanner is no longer used you can remove the driver: the maker's installer puts it back if you need it.

Name: Tools of other PC makers (Toshiba, Fujitsu, Gigabyte, ASRock...)
What: Utilities and drivers installed by the maker of the PC or the motherboard: function keys, power, fans, lighting.
IfNeeded: Needed if the keys, brightness, fans or lighting of the PC depend on them: check before removing.
IfNotNeeded: If everything works without them or you replaced the PC or the board, you can remove them. When unsure, keep them.

Name: Antivirus and security software
What: Network, filter and protection drivers installed by an antivirus or security program.
IfNeeded: Needed while that program is installed: removing them can switch off the protection or break the network.
IfNotNeeded: If the program was uninstalled, the leftovers can be removed (restart the PC afterwards).

Name: VPN and virtual network services
What: Virtual network adapters of VPN and private-network services (ZeroTier, Tailscale, Hamachi, commercial VPNs).
IfNeeded: Needed while you use that service: without the adapter the VPN does not connect.
IfNotNeeded: If you no longer use the service or uninstalled the app, the adapter can be removed.

Match: OBS Virtual|OBS-Camera|Virtual Camera|ManyCam|XSplit|Snap Camera|\bNDI\b|Camo|DroidCam|Iriun|EpocCam|Elgato Virtual|Logi Capture|Webcam virtuale
Name: Virtual cameras (OBS, DroidCam, NDI...)
What: Drivers that create a virtual webcam, for example to use the phone as a camera or to send video from OBS to meetings.
IfNeeded: Needed if you use that program as a camera in calls or streaming.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use it or the app is not installed, you can remove it.

Name: Capture cards and TV tuners
What: Drivers of video capture cards and TV tuners (Blackmagic, AVerMedia, Magewell, DVB...).
IfNeeded: Needed if you use the card to record, stream or watch TV.
IfNotNeeded: If the card is no longer in the PC you can remove the driver.

Name: Professional audio interfaces (ASIO)
What: Drivers of USB audio interfaces and mixers for music and recording (Focusrite, Behringer, PreSonus, RME, MOTU...).
IfNeeded: Needed if you record or play music with that interface.
IfNotNeeded: If the interface is not connected you can remove the driver: the maker's installer puts it back when you need it.

Name: Android emulators (BlueStacks, Nox, LDPlayer...)
What: Virtual network and acceleration drivers installed by Android emulators.
IfNeeded: Needed while you use the emulator.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use the emulator or uninstalled it, the leftovers can be removed.

Name: Windows virtual network adapters
What: Virtual adapters that Windows creates by itself: IPv6 tunnels (Teredo, 6to4, ISATAP, IP-HTTPS) and WAN miniports for VPN and PPPoE.
IfNeeded: Windows needs them for IPv6 tunnels, VPN and PPPoE connections.
IfNotNeeded: As ghost devices they are safe to remove: Windows creates them again when needed.

Match: Remote Desktop (Device|Camera|Easy Print|Audio)|RDPDR|rdpbus|Remote Audio|Desktop remoto|Terminal Server
Name: Remote Desktop components
What: Virtual devices that Windows creates for Remote Desktop: redirected audio, printers, cameras and drives.
IfNeeded: Windows uses them when you connect to or from this PC with Remote Desktop.
IfNotNeeded: As ghost devices they are safe to remove: Windows creates them again at the next remote session.

Name: Hardware monitoring and tuning tools
What: Drivers installed by programs that read sensors or tune the hardware (Afterburner, HWiNFO, CPU-Z, AIDA64, RGB tools).
IfNeeded: Needed only while you use those programs.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use them or uninstalled them, the leftovers can be removed. Some old ones of this kind are flagged by security tools, another reason to remove them.

Name: File system and encryption drivers
What: Drivers that let Windows read other file systems (Mac, Linux) or mount encrypted and network volumes (VeraCrypt, WinFsp, Dokan).
IfNeeded: Needed if you use those disks or encrypted volumes: do not remove them while a volume is mounted.
IfNotNeeded: If you no longer use them or the app is not installed, the leftovers can be removed.

Name: UPS (battery backup)
What: Driver and software of an uninterruptible power supply connected by USB, used to see the battery and shut the PC down safely.
IfNeeded: Needed if a UPS is connected to this PC and you want the PC to shut down by itself when the power fails.
IfNotNeeded: If you no longer have the UPS you can remove it.

Name: Musical instruments and MIDI
What: Drivers of keyboards, controllers and music equipment connected by USB or MIDI.
IfNeeded: Needed if you play or record with those instruments on this PC.
IfNotNeeded: If the instrument is not connected you can remove the driver: Windows or the maker's installer puts it back when you connect it.

Name: Radio (SDR) dongles and USB tools
What: Drivers installed with Zadig or libusb to use radio dongles (RTL-SDR, HackRF, Airspy) and similar USB tools.
IfNeeded: Needed if you use the dongle with SDR programs.
IfNotNeeded: If you do not use it you can remove the driver: the device goes back to its normal Windows driver or to none.

Match: Device Association|Radio Device Enumeration|Enumerat|Composite Bus|Bus composito|Archiviazione volumi|Storage Volumes|Volume Manager|\bVolume\b|Software Device|Plug and Play Software|Virtual Drive|unità virtuale|NDIS Virtual|Spazi di archiviazione|Storage Spaces|UMBus
Name: Windows enumerators and system buses
What: Software buses and enumerators that Windows creates to manage devices: device association, radio devices, virtual drives, virtual network adapters, composite bus, storage volumes.
IfNeeded: They are part of Windows itself: they are always present and needed.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove them. If one shows up as a not-connected entry Windows creates it again, so there is nothing to gain.

Match: ACPI|Risorse scheda madre|Motherboard Resources|Programmable Interrupt|Timer di sistema|System Timer|High Precision Event|Timer eventi|Standard SATA AHCI|AHCI SATA|RAM standard|Standard RAM|System Management BIOS|SMBIOS|Charge Arbitration|arbitraggio ricarica|PS/2|HID I2C|HID-compliant|compatibile HID|Input Configuration|USB Input Device|Dispositivo di input USB|Root Hub|Hub radice|USB Composite|USB composito|eXtensible Host Controller|xHCI|Controller host USB
Name: Standard PC components (ACPI, timers, USB and input)
What: Basic parts of the PC that Windows manages with its own drivers: ACPI, system timers, motherboard resources, SATA and USB controllers, hubs and HID input devices.
IfNeeded: Needed while the hardware is present: the PC does not work correctly without them.
IfNotNeeded: Never remove them while connected. Only entries of devices that are no longer present (for example an old USB hub or mouse) can be removed safely.

Match: Host Bridge|DRAM Registers|LPC Controller|eSPI|SPI \(flash\)|PCI Express Root Port|PCI Express Root Complex|Complesso radice PCI
Name: Intel chipset core (bridges, LPC/eSPI, PCI Express, SPI)
What: Core devices of the Intel chipset: host bridge, LPC/eSPI controller, PCI Express ports and SPI flash controller.
IfNeeded: Always needed: the motherboard depends on them.
IfNotNeeded: Do not remove them. Update them only through the chipset package of the PC maker.
